title: Email: Fw: FENECH 12:30pm Sports Center Segment

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Altman, Lana R. <Lana.R.Altman@espn.com>
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2015 9:09 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: FENECH 12:30pm Sports Center Segment 
 
That’s perfect, Anthony, thanks!
I will be in touch with exact questions in a moment.

From: Fenech, Anthony [mailto:afenech@freepress.com] 
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2015 9:09 AM
To: Altman, Lana R.
Subject: Re: FENECH 12:30pm Sports Center Segment
Hi Lana, thanks for having me on.
A few things: Tigers at the trade deadline and what they could do, How important Justin Verlander is to the second half and what Miguel Cabrera's injury means to the team.

Anthony Fenech
Detroit Free Press
Tigers beat writer
c: 734-752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech

From: Altman, Lana R. <Lana.R.Altman@espn.com>
Sent: Friday, July 17, 2015 8:32:51 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony
Subject: FENECH 12:30pm Sports Center Segment
I wanted to reach out and introduce myself. I will be producing your 12:30pm segment for Sports Center, and will be your point of contact for that show.

Please let me know if there’s anything you’re particularly hot on, and we’ll do our best to work it into the segment. We will definitely want to look at the second half of the season, and what the Tigers need to do to really put themselves in contention. Please let me know if there are any specifics we can touch on there, or anything else you’re hearing.
Once I hear from you, I will send exact questions.
